answer: Each agent may open only a jetty-backed account after locking a scarce deposit that is forfeited if its actions trigger a fraud proof. A sonnet of independent agents can challenge suspicious duplicate behavior by posting evidence on-chain; if the claim is upheld, the target loses its bond, while false challengers lose theirs. This makes a sybil spiral costly: an attacker must fund every identity and risk repeated deposits, rather than multiplying influence for free.
